title: Shukriya ay hazrate shabbir
body:
ALLAH…….(4)
BISMILLAH HIR REHMAN NIR RAHIM
ALLAH RAHIM HAIN ALLAH KARIM HAIN ALLAH AZEEM ALLAH REHMAN HAIN
FABE AYYE AALAA E RABBE KUMA TUKAZZEBAAN….(2)
SURA E REMAN KKI TAFSEER…..YA HUSSAIN
KHWABE IBRAHIM KI TAABEER
SHUKRIYA AY HAZRATE SHABBIR………(3)
NASL DAR NASL AZADAAR BANANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN….(2)
KEHTE HAIN GHAR MEIN AZAKHAANA SAJANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
KHAALIQE ARZ O SAMAA BHI TERA MAMNOON HUA
APNE HI KHOO SE WUZU JAB TAHE SHAMSHEER KIYA
MERE SAJDO KO NAMAZO KO BACHANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
AY HUSSAIN IBNE ALI NOORE NIGAAHE ZEHRA
BEHRE TAZDEEQ TAHE TEGH HAI SAJDA TERA
MAUT KO JEENE KE AADAAB SIKHANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
ZULM KO TUNE HADO SE KABHI BADHNE NA DIYA
SABR KI DHAAL PA HAR WAAR SITAM KA ROKA
SABR MAZLOOM KA HATHYAAR BANANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
SHUKRE KHUDA KE BAAD KARO SHUKRE MUSTUFA
PHIR BAARGAAHE FATEMA ZEHRA MEIN SAR JHUKA
MAULA ALI SE MAANG MADAD SHUKR KAR ADAA
PHIR NAAM LE HUSSAIN ALAYHISSALAAM KA
YAANI HASAN HUSSAIN NABI FATEMA ALI
LE PAANCH NAAM NAARA LAGA YEH GALI GALI
HAJ KO UMRE SE BADALNA KOI AASAAN NA THA
TARKE AULA KA BHI TUJHME KOI IMKAAN NA THA
HURMATE KAABA KO FITNO SE BACHANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
ZAKHMI MERA HUSSAIN
PYASAA MERA HUSSAIN
TANHA MERA HUSSAIN
MAZLOOM YA HUSSAIN
WAQT EK AISA BHI AAYA KE KHUDA BOL UTHA
EERJAEE EERJAEE AB MERI TARAF LAUT KE AA
BUDHE KAANDHO PE JAWAA LASH UTHANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
FATEMA KEHTI THI TO QATL HUA BE TAKSEER
MERE PYASE MERE MAZLOOM MUSAFIR SHABBIR
JASHN MAQTAL MEIN SHAHADAT KA MANANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
BOLA QURAA’N YEH EHSAAN UTAARU KAISE
BAR SARE NOKE SINA MUJHPE JO EHSAAN KIYE
MERI AAWAAZ  MEIN AAWAAZ MILANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
KYA BULANDI KI SANAD KARBOBALA KO BAKSHI
ROSHNI TAABA ABAD DEENE KHUDA KO BAKSHI
APNE KHAIME KE CHARAAGO KO BUJHANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
US TARAF MAJMAA THA NAU LAKH SITAMGAARO KA
IS TARAF SIRF SHAHE DEE KE BAHATTAR RUFQAA
DEKE JAA KEHTE RAHE SAR KO KATANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
RAB NE “REHAN” SARE ARSH YEH MAULA SE KAHA
NASLE IMRAN KE HOTE NAHI DEE KO KHATRA
ZINDA JAB TAK HAIN TERA NAUHA SUNANE WALE
SHUKRIYA YA HUSSAIN..(2)YA HUSSAIN….(3)
